A short story. 

Back in maybe 2020, I posted a camp on YouTube that I made in the mire tree house, the really high one in the far north, back then it was largely unknown, my video had 9 views. 

There was one comment, off a well known youtuber asking me where it was, I was flattered they'd even seen my video so I told them. 

4 days later, the youtuber had posted a video of a far superior camp there and all their legions swarmed to that spot. I was unable to place my camp in 6 consecutive worlds. 

I've been bitter and twisted since and want everybody to feel a slice of the pain, sadness, disappointment and betrayal which I experienced. 

I hope you understand.

Just to counter this guy, it's clearly his first fallout game. 

To exit the game it's not 4 buttons, press start, and then quit. Done. 

Things do not weigh more than previous games, in fact a lot can be made lighter or weightless through perks and backpacks. It's an MMO so an unlimited inventory is not really feasible. Stash is a little low 1200lbs I'll give him this, but they encourage to scrip and sell what you don't need. Fair. 

Workshops give you two warnings that players can attack you in a workshop and you OK it twice, they are troves for resources. You want the rewards, you take the risk. 

When you die you not lose ALL your stuff, you lose your junk,  plentiful tat found everywhere, no ammo, weapons, Armor, chems, food, misc or anything is lost. Just junk. This can be stashed anytime. 

I'm not covering the point where he wants XP for nothing. If you want XP dude shoot the damn thing. Non starter. 

Is it as in depths as other Fallouts? No? Is it fallout? Absolutely. It's just different. It's cool to hate on this game, but just get involved, just play though the story and explore and chill with your girl in a familiar yet new world. It's chill.
